title: Define pipeline preprocess stage for pre-ack reactions, path mapping, and STT normalization
description: AstrBot has a PreProcessStage before wake/process handling that sends optional platform pre-ack reactions, rewrites media paths, and converts Record components to Plain text through the selected STT provider. Rust currently has policy stages and STT providers, but no dedicated preprocessing boundary.

files.change: Define a stage boundary for pre-ack reactions, media path mapping, and STT text normalization before process/provider stages.
Expose typed ports for pre-ack reaction sink, path mapping, and STT provider lookup without reaching into runtime globals.
Keep local/remote media path rewrite rules outside provider adapters and message component types.

criteria: Preprocessing can be tested independently from wake, process, and respond stages.
Record-to-Plain STT conversion uses provider capability ports and does not couple pipeline code to concrete STT providers.
Platform pre-ack reactions and path mapping remain optional policy/config behavior.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
